title: •Vader’s Personal Shuttle
caption: •Vader’s Personal Shuttle (V)
game_text: May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. Vader deploys -3 aboard. While Vader piloting at a battleground, maneuver +2 and you lose no Force to Uncontrollable Fury or You Must Confront Vader.
lore: Customized transport of Lord Vader. Employs advanced sensor jamming gear. Modified with enhanced tactical displays constructed to the Dark Lord’s specifications.

notes: Group: Everything else (sheet page 'Virtual Set 16: Everything else', DARK SIDE). Unique (•). Banner 'STARFIGHTER: _LAMBDA_-CLASS SHUTTLE' with 'Lambda' in italic. Stats POWER 2 / MANEUVER 3 / HYPERSPEED 5; deploy 2 / forfeit 4. Scomp-link ring left of the text box → scomp true. Icon column: Nav Computer only (printed card: Pilot, Nav, Scomp). Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Nate Meeker' / 'World Champion 2006' → credit_bottom. Curly apostrophes in Vader’s (title/caption) and Lord’s (lore). Slip text matches the stub. Lore matches the scan and V0 remake. Copyright SE 1998 line read off the V0 remake. Modern: V0-D-vaderspersonalshuttle.gif (745); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
